candidates.excerpt: **Cristóbal Valenzuela** (born 1989) is a [Chilean](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chile)\-born technologist, software developer, and CEO of [Runway](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Runway_\(company\)).

citations.excerpt: In 2018, Valenzuela co-founded the AI research company [Runway](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Runway_\(company\))[\[1\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crist%C3%B3bal_Valenzuela#cite_note-:1-1)[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crist%C3%B3bal_Valenzuela#cite_note-2) in [New York City](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York_City) with Anastasis Germanidis and Alejandro Matamala.
